disposition_reason: Original ICP-MS measurements of Pb, Cd, Hg, As and six other elements in 307 milk, yogurt, cheese and mozzarella samples from organic, conventional farm and retail chains in Romania.

study.design: Cross-sectional multi-matrix survey of farm and retail milk and dairy products
study.origin: North-western Romania: organic farm series Salaj County (Criseni); conventional farm series Satu Mare County (Certeze, Moiseni); buffalo products Certeze area
study.market: Retail outlets in north-western Romania for commercial cow milk, yogurt and cheese

period.as_reported: Organic series 5 October 2025; conventional farm series 24 October 2025; commercial/retail and buffalo products 30 October 2025

study.method: ICP-MS (helium KED collision mode) after microwave digestion with HNO3/H2O2
lod: LOD defined as 3 SD of 10 procedural blanks / calibration slope; numeric LODs only in Supplementary Material
study.qa: NIST SRM 1549 non-fat milk powder recoveries 96-104%; FAPAS whole milk QC Z-scores -0.17 to +0.15
